title: Relationship
description: A typed edge between two entities (housamkak v3 §6.5) — one line of llm-wiki/states/relationships.jsonl, a view aggregated from the observations that assert it. predicate is canonical — the observation's word mapped through PREDICATE_CANON at view build, unknown legacy words falling to related_to — and relationship_id = rel_ + 12 hex of sha256(subject_entity · canonical predicate · object_entity · qualifiers), so two legacy spellings of one edge fold into one row. status is stance-aware: active while any of its claims is candidate, active, stale, or archived; disputed when every asserting observation has stance contradicts, or when its claims are all disputed; superseded when all its claims are frozen — superseded, rejected, or both, since this enum has no rejected. scripts/llm-wiki/graph.py walks these edges read-only.

contradicting_observations.description: The observations that assert this edge with stance contradicts; they subtract their weight from probability instead of adding it.
